name: Daniel McLafferty
tagline: Top rated Insurance Coverage attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Daniel McLafferty is a personal injury attorney at the law firm Bastion Law, PLLC, which has its offices in Seattle, Washington. Licensed to practice law in Washington since 2012, he represents clients with matters involving brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, wrongful death, medical malpractice, defective products and insurance bad faith.

With a Bachelor of Arts degree in philosophy and political science, Mr. McLafferty graduated from the Western Washington University. He went on to study law at the Seattle University School of Law and obtained his Juris Doctor graduating cum laude. During law school, he served as a Rule 9 Prosecutor for Marysville and gained invaluable courtroom experience.

Mr. McLafferty was an active participant in his law school’s Mock Trial competitions and Appellate Moot Court competitions. He was also the recipient of the CALI Excellence for the Future Award in criminal motions practice. Right after law school, he joined an insurance coverage defense law firm and acquired much knowledge about how insurance companies work, and this experience made him choose to work for the rights of people instead of large insurance companies.

With a genuine concern for his clients, Mr. McLafferty is a zealous and tireless advocate for his clients. Dedicated to fighting for his clients who have been harmed due to another party’s careless and negligent actions, he diligently fights for their rights and liberties.

Mr. McLafferty has memberships in the American Association for Justice, the Washington State Association for Justice, the King County Bar Association and the Washington State Bar Association’s Young Lawyers Committee. In honor of his exceptional contributions, he has a “Superb” rating on Avvo and was the recipient of Avvo’s Clients’ Choice award and Top Contributor award.
